scope: Human-guided phenomenological annotations plus deterministic prior-dream-record provenance comparison

catalog.definition: Specific prior-dream recollection with temporal context.
Dream-associated elements without a specific dated dream.
Dream-like current feeling or consciousness state.

cases.fact: Orange-room recollection;reported yesterday or two days earlier.
Character/fear recollection with uncertain dream attribution.
Hospital imagery;retain authors category despite contextual words.

compatibility_precedence: Explicit uncertainty or conflicting declarations -> review_required. Specific recollection with denied dream association; temporal context with denied specific recollection; recalled dream mixed with present dreamy-state -> conflicting.
Specific recollection,dream association and specific temporal context,without present dreamy-state -> episodic_like_compatible.
Dream-associated familiarity without specific recollection,present dreamy-state or specific temporal context -> familiarity_like_compatible.
Present dreamy-state without specific recollection or familiarity -> dreamy_state_compatible;not remembered prior dream.
Generic familiarity with denied dream association and no prior recollection or dreamy-state -> unsupported.
All other incomplete combinations -> unclassifiable. Temporal vague/unknown with specific recollection remains unclassifiable.
editorial_policy: Conservative compatibility policy,not authors clinical consensus algorithm. Raw narrative is never parsed for category inference. Proposal preserved independently;disagreement exposed. Confidence never supplies missing evidence.
chronology: Timezone-aware closed intervals;compare every original lock separately to experience,first report,event. Identical point boundary only -> equal;touching non-point interval -> ambiguous. Invalid reversed interval rejects. Missing original version rejects;missing original first/lock -> unknown;lock before original first or occurrence after first -> conflicting evidence. Hashes are not clocks.
privacy: Local pseudonymous private records. Consent/local processing and rights required;export unsupported in v1. CLI stdout/private JSON includes raw text and must remain private. Reference has no participant data.
limits: No neurological diagnosis,localization or stimulation advice
No future-event prediction or resemblance probability
Local owner may rewrite a hash chain;timestamps,identity,consent and knowledge are declarations
Clinical source examples do not validate consumer classification

supported: Immutable original and append-only narrative versions
Finite exact-ID candidate ledger and manual nonmatch accounting
Timezone-aware chronology and exact JSON/Markdown replay
experimental: Applying clinical phenomenology to ordinary self-report
